instruction: Recreate the original image as a single-slide PowerPoint presentation with content identical to the original image. It must be editable. Use SimSun for all content, set the line width to 0.75 pt, set the diagram height to 7 cm, and center the diagram on the slide.

dim1: The delivered file is in .ppt or .pptx format and can be opened normally.
The delivered PowerPoint presentation contains only 1 slide, with a landscape 16:9 aspect ratio.
dim2: +5: Complete flowchart grouped object on Slide 1: The left boundary of the grouped object is 10.5-11.5 cm from the left edge of the slide, and its top boundary is 5.5-6.5 cm from the top edge of the slide; its width is 12.44 cm and its height is 7.00 cm.

+5: Top title background on Slide 1: Located at the top of the complete flowchart grouped object, with a width of 12.44 cm and a height of 0.80 cm; it has a dark teal fill, rounded top-left and top-right corners, and a straight horizontal bottom edge.

+5: Top title text on Slide 1: The text is “Industrial Park Reclaimed Water Treatment Process and Water Quality Assurance Pathway,” located in the center of the title background; the font is SimSun, 12-14 pt, bold, and white, with horizontal and vertical center alignment.

+3: Main section outer frame on Slide 1: Located within the complete flowchart grouped object, 0-0.5 cm from its left edge and 0.6-1.2 cm from its top edge; it is 12.18 cm wide and 5.82 cm high, shaped as a white rounded rectangle with a solid teal outline and a line width of 0.75 pt.

+5: Main section background columns on Slide 1: The main section outer frame contains 10 light blue-gray vertical rectangular color bands, each corresponding to one treatment step box. The bands have identical widths and aligned top and bottom edges, and all text is contained within the text boxes.

+5: On Slide 1, treatment step boxes 1-10: Located within the complete flowchart grouped object, 0.40-12.3 cm from its left edge and 1.5-4.5 cm from its top edge; each box is 0.80-0.90 cm wide and 2-3 cm high. The numbers at the top are “1”-“10,” respectively, and the body texts, from left to right, are “Integrated Plant Wastewater Collection,” “Coarse Screen and Equalization Well,” “pH Equalization Tank,” “Coagulation and Sedimentation Tank,” “Multimedia Filter,” “Activated Carbon Adsorption Tower,” “Ultrafiltration Membrane Module,” “Ultrafiltration Membrane Module,” “Reclaimed Clear Water Tank,” and “Cooling Water Makeup System.” The spacing between every two treatment step boxes is 0.3-0.5 cm.

+5: Treatment step box style on Slide 1: All 10 step boxes are white rounded rectangles with solid cyan or green outlines and a line width of 0.75 pt. Their top and bottom edges are aligned, and their widths and spacing are consistent.

+5: Treatment step body text on Slide 1: All 10 step names use SimSun, 8-10 pt, bold, and black, arranged with a line break after each character or in narrow text boxes, with horizontal and vertical center alignment.

+5: Treatment step number circles on Slide 1: All 10 number circles have a diameter of 0.25-0.30 cm, a cyan or green fill, and a teal 0.75 pt outline. The numbers use Times New Roman, 9 pt, bold, and white, and are placed at the top inside the treatment step boxes.

+5: Horizontal arrows between steps on Slide 1: Between the 10 step boxes, there are 9 dark blue horizontal single arrows, each pointing from the right edge of the preceding step box to the left edge of the following step box. All arrows have a line width of 0.75 pt, point from left to right, and are 0.3-0.5 cm long.

+1: Acid-Alkali Adjustment annotation box on Slide 1: Located within the complete flowchart grouped object, 2.5-4 cm from its left edge and 4.3-5 cm from its top edge; it is 1.2-1.3 cm wide and 0.3-0.4 cm high, with the text “Acid-Alkali Adjustment” and an editable flask icon on the left.

+1: PAC/PAM Dosing annotation box on Slide 1: Located within the complete flowchart grouped object, 3.5-5 cm from its left edge and 4.3-5 cm from its top edge; it is 1.3-1.4 cm wide and 0.3-0.4 cm high, with the text “PAC/PAM Dosing” and an editable chemical-agent icon on the left.

+1: Core Purification Unit annotation box on Slide 1: Located within the complete flowchart grouped object, 6.4-8.4 cm from its left edge and 4.3-5 cm from its top edge; it is 1.4-1.6 cm wide and 0.3-0.4 cm high, with the text “Core Purification Unit” and an editable water droplet icon on the left.

+3: Sodium Hypochlorite Dosing annotation box on Slide 1: Located within the complete flowchart grouped object, 8.3-10.1 cm from its left edge and 4.3-5 cm from its top edge; it is 1.5-1.6 cm wide and 0.3-0.4 cm high, with the text “Sodium Hypochlorite Dosing” and an editable shield icon on the left.
+3: Auxiliary annotation box style on Slide 1: All 4 annotation boxes are very light green rounded rectangles with teal 0.75 pt outlines. The text uses SimSun, 5-7 pt, and dark green.

+3: Auxiliary annotation dashed arrows on Slide 1: The 4 annotation boxes are connected by teal vertical dashed arrows to the bottoms of step boxes 3, 4, 7, and 8, respectively. All arrows have a line width of 0.75 pt, point upward, and are 0.3-0.5 cm long.

+5: Abnormal return pipeline on Slide 1: Extends leftward from below step box 9 along the lower portion of the main section, then turns into a vertical upward arrow below the middle of step box 2 and connects to step box 2. The pipeline is a dark blue elbow line, with a horizontal length of 7.7-7.9 cm, a vertical length of 1.4-1.5 cm, and a line width of 0.75 pt.

+3: Abnormal Return label on Slide 1: Located within the complete flowchart grouped object, 4.8-6 cm from its left edge and 5.3-5.8 cm from its top edge; it is 0.9-1.1 cm wide and 0.3-0.4 cm high, with a dark blue fill and the text “Abnormal Return” in SimSun, 5-7 pt, bold, and white.

+5: Landscaping and Flushing Reuse box on Slide 1: Located within the complete flowchart grouped object, 9.6-12.3 cm from its left edge and 5.10-5.8 cm from its top edge; it is 2.2-2.3 cm wide and 0.5-0.6 cm high. It is a white rounded rectangle with a teal 0.75 pt outline, a green leaf icon on the left, and the text “Landscaping and Flushing Reuse.”

+3: Downward arrow from the Reclaimed Clear Water Tank on Slide 1: Extends vertically downward from the bottom of step box 9 and connects to the top of the “Landscaping and Flushing Reuse” box. It is dark blue, has a line width of 0.75 pt, points downward, and is 1-1.2 cm long.

+5: Bottom assurance information bar on Slide 1: Located within the complete flowchart grouped object, 0.3-12.2 cm from its left edge and 5.8-6.8 cm from its top edge; it is 11-12 cm wide and 0.6-0.8 cm high. It is a very light blue rounded rectangle with a blue-green 0.75 pt outline.

+3: Dividers in the bottom assurance information bar on Slide 1: The information bar contains 3 blue-green vertical dashed lines that divide it into 4 equal-width sections. Each line has a width of 0.75 pt and a length of 0.4-0.6 cm.

+1: On Slide 1, bottom assurance module 1: Contains an editable shield-with-plus icon, with the main text “Full-Process Online Monitoring” and the secondary text “pH/Turbidity/Residual Chlorine/Conductivity.”
+1: On Slide 1, bottom assurance module 2: Contains an editable clipboard icon, with the main text “Water Quality Compliance Assurance” and the secondary text “Meets Reuse Water Quality Standards.”
+1: On Slide 1, bottom assurance module 3: Contains an editable gear icon, with the main text “Regular Equipment Maintenance” and the secondary text “Ensures Stable System Operation.”
+1: On Slide 1, bottom assurance module 4: Contains an editable document icon, with the main text “Data Record Traceability” and the secondary text “Visualized and Traceable Management.”
+1: Text in the bottom assurance modules on Slide 1: The main text in all 4 modules uses SimSun, 6 pt. The main text is bold and dark blue; the secondary text is gray and uses SimSun, 5 pt.

+3: Overall color scheme on Slide 1: The title background, number circles, and step borders use dark teal and teal; the step arrows and return pipeline use dark blue; the main section and step boxes use white; and the bottom information bar uses very light blue.
